messages:
Sam (Partnerships): BridgeCore PO is in QA hold. Vendor uploaded a signed PO but the marketplace portal flagged the EDI vendor id and tax info mismatch. Procurement flagged for tax/EIN verification. Can Procurement allow a temporary alias mapping so the integration can go live for the demo next week? @Tara please advise.
Tara (Procurement): Portal rejects on two reasons: EDI_ID_MISMATCH and TAX_ID_MISMATCH. We need either a corrected PO with the expected vendor legal name + EIN or an official vendor letter on company letterhead that ties the two names together. Can't accept a PO where the EIN doesn't match our remit.
marketplace-bot: ingestion -> REJECTED {"ticket":"MP-99112","reasons":["edi_id_mismatch","tax_id_mismatch"],"expected_vendor":"BridgeCore LLC","received_vendor":"BridgeCore Technologies","received_ein":"12-3456789","portal_vendor_ein":"98-7654321"}
BridgeCore CSM: Vendor says their finance team uploaded the PO from their EU entity by mistake (BridgeCore Technologies). They can re-upload, but their US finance lead is OOO until Monday. They offered an interim vendor attestation PDF and a scanned W-9 — but the EIN on the scanned W-9 still points to the EU parent.
Priya (Finance): I can't approve vendor mapping or payment rails without EIN match. If Legal signs off on a provisional mapping, I can create a temporary payment bucket `TMP-BC-2025` for ACH holds, but funds will not be released until EIN verification is complete.
Jordan (Sales): Heads-up: we have a customer demo and partner co-marketing on Thursday. Sales needs the integration toggled on by Wednesday EOD. Can Partnerships help escalate to the vendor AE/channel lead for a corrected PO?
Ethan (Legal): We can accept a vendor attestation plus a signed indemnity for tax mismatch as a short-term measure, but it must include: explicit identification of both legal entities, EINs, statement of authorization, and a commitment to cure within 5 business days. I'll draft a short attestation template and post to MP-99112. This is a risk-tolerant, temporary exception not a substitute for corrected legal docs.
Tara (Procurement): If Legal provides that attestation template and the vendor signs, Procurement can mark the ticket as "provisionally accepted" for 3 business days to allow a soft enable in the portal. After that we need corrected PO or updated vendor registration. No payment release until Finance clears.
BridgeCore CSM: Noted — will push to vendor AE and FP&A now. They asked if DocuSign is ok and whether a scanned letter can suffice if DocuSign unavailable.
Ethan (Legal): DocuSign preferred. If vendor insists on scanned letter, require notarization and include signatory authority clause. Otherwise proceed with DocuSign template. I'll attach the template in 30 minutes.
marketplace-bot: ticket update -> MP-99112 status: PROVISIONAL_PENDING_DOCUMENTS.
Priya (Finance): Once signed attestation is attached to MP-99112 I will create `TMP-BC-2025` as a hold-only account and set payment status to "pending verification". No payouts until EIN matches.
Sam (Partnerships): Action items: 1) Ethan to post attestation template, 2) BridgeCore CSM to get DocuSign signed attestation ASAP, 3) Priya to create temporary hold account on attachment, 4) Tara to provisionally accept in portal for 3 business days. If we don't have signed attestation by EOD Tuesday, Jordan please push the announcement/demos to next week.
Jordan (Sales): Will loop in AE/channel lead and hold press schedule tentatively.
BridgeCore CSM: Pushing now, flagged as "urgent - demo window". Vendor committed to DocuSign within 24 hours per AE. Will update ticket with delivery ETA.
Sam (Partnerships): Thanks everyone. I'll monitor MP-99112 and ping if anything slips. :raised_hands:
